thread.document:
Please submit final reports to:  https://cmt3.research.microsoft.com/DLFP2025

Note that this is technically a different "conference" than the one you guys used for drafts. The process for making a submission should be the same as last time though. 

However, this means that you all should have received another reviewer invitation for this conference. Please accept the reviewer invite as soon as possible, so we can (hopefully) do reviewer assignments more smoothly.

comments.content: <document version="2.0"><paragraph>It is in everyone's interest to add an appendix addressing how you incorporated peer-reviewer feedback on your draft submission into this version. </paragraph><paragraph>This helps you for yourself (making sure you didn't miss something) as well as demonstrates sincerity towards the reviewers who will be looking at your current version. </paragraph><paragraph>For the final final submission to gradescope (that happens after the peer review and poster session), we will make this requirement much more explicit. </paragraph><paragraph/></document>
comments.document:
It is in everyone's interest to add an appendix addressing how you incorporated peer-reviewer feedback on your draft submission into this version. 

This helps you for yourself (making sure you didn't miss something) as well as demonstrates sincerity towards the reviewers who will be looking at your current version. 

For the final final submission to gradescope (that happens after the peer review and poster session), we will make this requirement much more explicit.
